abroad.usageZh: 副词，不与 in 连用：go / live / study abroad。表示到国外或在国外。

examples.sentence: I want to travel abroad next summer.
examples.trans: 我明年夏天想出国旅行。

examples.sentence: She hopes to study abroad next year to improve her language skills.
examples.trans: 她希望明年出国留学以提高语言。

examples.sentence: My uncle works abroad and calls us on Sundays.
examples.trans: 我叔叔在国外工作，星期天给我们打电话。

examples.sentence: Living abroad forces you to use the language for real needs.
examples.trans: 住在国外迫使你为真实需要使用语言。

examples.sentence: Going abroad is not automatically growing up.
examples.trans: 出国并不自动等于成长。

examples.sentence: Policy that treats study abroad as a luxury has already chosen who may see the world.
examples.trans: 把出国留学当奢侈的政策，已经选好了谁可以看见世界。

popular.usageZh: 形容词：be popular with / among。反义词 unpopular。名词 popularity。

examples.sentence: This song is popular in our class.
examples.trans: 这首歌在我们班很受欢迎。

examples.sentence: This song is very popular among young adults.
examples.trans: 这首歌在年轻人中很受欢迎。

examples.sentence: A popular beach can still be the wrong beach for a quiet week.
examples.trans: 受欢迎的海滩仍可能不适合安静的一周。

examples.sentence: A popular route is often a crowded route.
examples.trans: 受欢迎的路线常常是拥挤的路线。

examples.sentence: Popular travel advice can hide who the city was built for.
examples.trans: 流行的旅行建议可能藏起这座城市为谁而建。

examples.sentence: A popular destination can price out the people who made it worth visiting.
examples.trans: 受欢迎的目的地可能把造就它的人挤出去。

view.usageZh: 名词：a beautiful view；in my view；world view。动词 view 表示看待。

examples.sentence: The view from the hill is wide and green.
examples.trans: 山上的景色开阔而绿。

examples.sentence: From the top of the tower, you can get a fantastic view of the whole city.
examples.trans: 从塔顶可以看到整座城市的极好景色。

examples.sentence: In my view, slow trains beat cheap flights for a short holiday.
examples.trans: 在我看来，短假期里慢火车胜过廉价航班。

examples.sentence: A world view is built from trips and from books you trust.
examples.trans: 世界观由旅行和你信任的书建成。

examples.sentence: The hotel sells a view and hides the service lift.
examples.trans: 酒店出售景色，藏起服务电梯。

examples.sentence: Whose view of the skyline is protected is already a planning decision.
examples.trans: 谁的天际线视野被保护，已经是规划决定。

refresh.usageZh: 及物动词：refresh yourself / your mind / a page。形容词 refreshing。

examples.sentence: A short walk can refresh me after class.
examples.trans: 课后短走能让我振作。

examples.sentence: A short walk in the park can refresh your mind after a long study session.
examples.trans: 长时间学习后，公园短走能让头脑振作。

examples.sentence: The sea wind will refresh you better than another coffee.
examples.trans: 海风比再一杯咖啡更能让你振作。

examples.sentence: To refresh a tired team, change the room, not only the slide.
examples.trans: 要让疲倦的团队振作，就换房间，而不只换幻灯片。

examples.sentence: A holiday cannot refresh a job that is structurally cruel.
examples.trans: 假期无法让一份结构上残忍的工作振作。

examples.sentence: Cities refresh a riverfront for visitors and forget the people who live one street back.
examples.trans: 城市为游客振作河滨，却忘记往后一条街住的人。

relatives.usageZh: 名词复数：亲戚。单数 relative。visit relatives。

examples.sentence: We visit relatives at the New Year.
examples.trans: 新年我们去看亲戚。

examples.sentence: During the Spring Festival, we often visit our relatives and give them best wishes.
examples.trans: 春节我们常去拜访亲戚并送上祝福。

examples.sentence: Some relatives are maps of a family you only meet on trains.
examples.trans: 有些亲戚是你只在火车上遇见的家庭地图。

examples.sentence: Staying with relatives can be cheaper and more complicated than a hotel.
examples.trans: 住亲戚家可以比酒店更便宜，也更复杂。

examples.sentence: Relatives who fund a trip still do not own your itinerary.
examples.trans: 资助旅行的亲戚仍不拥有你的行程。

examples.sentence: Migration turns relatives into a network that money and visas must keep alive.
examples.trans: 迁徙把亲戚变成必须靠金钱和签证维持的网络。

culture.usageZh: 可数或不可数：local culture；cultures。形容词 cultural。

examples.sentence: I like the food culture in this town.
examples.trans: 我喜欢这个小镇的饮食文化。

examples.sentence: China has a long history and a rich culture that attracts people from all over the world.
examples.trans: 中国有悠久历史和吸引世界各地人们的丰富文化。

examples.sentence: A souvenir is not a culture, however brightly it is painted.
examples.trans: 纪念品不是文化，无论它画得多鲜亮。

examples.sentence: Learning a culture takes longer than learning a tense.
examples.trans: 学一种文化比学一个时态更久。

examples.sentence: Tourism that buys a culture as a show will empty it.
examples.trans: 把文化当演出买下的旅游会掏空它。

examples.sentence: Culture is the water we swim in and rarely name until we leave home.
examples.trans: 文化是我们游在其中、很少命名的水，直到我们离开家。

traditions.usageZh: 名词复数：family / local traditions。单数 tradition。形容词 traditional。

examples.sentence: Our family traditions include dumplings.
examples.trans: 我们的家庭传统包括饺子。

examples.sentence: Family traditions in my home include a big dinner together on New Year's Eve.
examples.trans: 我家的家庭传统包括除夕一起吃大餐。

examples.sentence: Some traditions travel well; some should stay in one kitchen.
examples.trans: 有些传统走得远；有些该留在一间厨房。

examples.sentence: Respecting traditions is not the same as freezing people in them.
examples.trans: 尊重传统不等于把人冻在传统里。

examples.sentence: Invented traditions can still comfort a traveller far from home.
examples.trans: 发明出来的传统仍能安慰远离家的旅人。

examples.sentence: A state that weaponises traditions is no longer preserving them.
examples.trans: 把传统当武器的国家，不再是在保存它们。

routine.usageZh: 名词：daily routine；break the routine。也可作形容词“常规的”。

examples.sentence: My morning routine is short and quiet.
examples.trans: 我的早晨常规又短又安静。

examples.sentence: My morning routine includes having breakfast, brushing my teeth, and then going to school.
examples.trans: 我的早晨常规包括吃早饭、刷牙，然后去上学。

examples.sentence: A trip is often an excuse to break a tired routine.
examples.trans: 旅行常常是打破疲倦常规的借口。

examples.sentence: A kind routine at a station matters more than a slogan on the wall.
examples.trans: 车站里友善的常规，比墙上的口号更重要。

examples.sentence: Holiday photos hide the routine that paid for the ticket.
examples.trans: 假期照片藏起为车票付账的常规。

examples.sentence: Bureaucracy is a routine that can either protect a passenger or exhaust one.
examples.trans: 官僚是一种常规，既能保护乘客，也能耗尽乘客。

memories.usageZh: 名词复数：happy memories。单数 memory。

examples.sentence: The photos keep our memories of the lake.
examples.trans: 照片保存着我们对湖的回忆。

examples.sentence: My trip to Hainan created many beautiful memories that I will never forget.
examples.trans: 海南之旅留下许多我不会忘记的美丽回忆。

examples.sentence: Not all memories of a journey are pretty, and that is all right.
examples.trans: 一段旅程的回忆并不都漂亮，那没关系。

examples.sentence: Shared memories are a kind of luggage you cannot lose at the gate.
examples.trans: 共享的回忆是一种你不会在门口丢掉的行李。

examples.sentence: Tourism sells memories it has already scripted.
examples.trans: 旅游业出售它已经写好脚本的回忆。

examples.sentence: Public memories of a place compete with the private ones of the people who stay.
examples.trans: 一个地方的公共回忆，与留下的人的私人回忆竞争。

complain.usageZh: 动词：complain about sth；complain that。名词 complaint。

examples.sentence: Don't complain about the rain all day.
examples.trans: 不要整天抱怨下雨。

examples.sentence: Don't complain about the homework; just try your best to finish it.
examples.trans: 不要抱怨作业；尽力做完就好。

examples.sentence: Travellers complain about queues they also help to make.
examples.trans: 旅行者抱怨他们自己也在制造的队伍。

examples.sentence: To complain well is to name a fix, not only a feeling.
examples.trans: 好好抱怨，就是点名一个修复，而不只是一种感觉。

examples.sentence: A review that only complains about the view has skipped the staff.
examples.trans: 只抱怨景色的评论跳过了员工。

examples.sentence: Citizens who cannot complain without being punished do not have a holiday problem; they have a rights problem.
examples.trans: 不能抱怨而不受罚的公民，面对的不是假期问题，是权利问题。

seaside.usageZh: 名词，常作定语：a seaside town / village。at the seaside。

examples.sentence: We spent Sunday at the seaside.
examples.trans: 我们在海滨度过了周日。

examples.sentence: We spent a wonderful weekend at a quiet seaside village.
examples.trans: 我们在安静的海滨村庄度过了美好周末。

examples.sentence: A seaside walk can repair a week of screens.
examples.trans: 海滨散步能修好一周的屏幕。

examples.sentence: Seaside towns live on a calendar they do not control.
examples.trans: 海滨小镇活在它们无法控制的日历上。

examples.sentence: A cheap seaside hotel can still be a kind one.
examples.trans: 便宜的海滨旅馆仍可以是友善的。

examples.sentence: Rising seas will redraw the map of every seaside economy that sells sun.
examples.trans: 上升的海面会重绘每一个贩卖阳光的海滨经济的地图。

recommendations.usageZh: 名词复数：give recommendations；based on recommendations。动词 recommend。

examples.sentence: Can you give me some recommendations for snacks?
examples.trans: 你能给我一些零食推荐吗？

examples.sentence: Can you give me some recommendations for interesting books to read?
examples.trans: 你能给我一些有趣的书的推荐吗？

examples.sentence: Local recommendations beat a list copied from a famous blog.
examples.trans: 本地推荐胜过从著名博客复制的名单。

examples.sentence: Follow recommendations you can check, not ones that only flatter the hotel.
examples.trans: 跟随你能核对的推荐，而不是只恭维酒店的那些。

examples.sentence: Paid recommendations should wear that word in the first line.
examples.trans: 付费推荐应在第一行戴上那个词。

examples.sentence: A ministry's travel recommendations are a public health document wearing a suitcase.
examples.trans: 部委的旅行推荐是穿着行李箱的公共卫生文件。

destinations.usageZh: 名词复数：tourist destinations。单数 destination。

examples.sentence: Paris and London are famous destinations.
examples.trans: 巴黎和伦敦是著名目的地。

examples.sentence: Paris and London are famous tourist destinations in Europe.
examples.trans: 巴黎和伦敦是欧洲著名旅游目的地。

examples.sentence: Quiet destinations need visitors who can lower their voices.
examples.trans: 安静的目的地需要能放低声音的访客。

examples.sentence: Choosing destinations is choosing whose streets will carry your noise.
examples.trans: 选择目的地，就是选择谁的街道将承载你的噪音。

examples.sentence: Overvisited destinations teach a lesson about love that kills.
examples.trans: 过度到访的目的地，教的是一种杀死所爱之物的课。

examples.sentence: Climate will edit the list of summer destinations faster than any guidebook.
examples.trans: 气候会比任何指南更快地编辑夏季目的地名单。

magnificent.usageZh: 形容词，描述景色、建筑或经历极其出色。副词 magnificently。

examples.sentence: We saw a magnificent sunset yesterday.
examples.trans: 我们昨天看见了壮丽的日落。

examples.sentence: We saw a magnificent sunset over the mountains yesterday.
examples.trans: 我们昨天看见了山上壮丽的日落。

examples.sentence: The hall looked magnificent, and the tickets were not.
examples.trans: 大厅看起来壮丽，票价却不。

examples.sentence: A magnificent view can still sit above an unfair wage.
examples.trans: 壮丽的景色仍可能坐落在不公平的工资之上。

examples.sentence: Ruin can be magnificent and still be a place where someone cooks dinner.
examples.trans: 废墟可以壮丽，仍是有人做晚饭的地方。

examples.sentence: The magnificent station was funded by a tax the guidebook never mentions.
examples.trans: 这座壮丽车站的资金来自指南从不提及的税。

frequently.usageZh: 副词：发生频率高。形容词 frequent。

examples.sentence: He frequently goes to the library.
examples.trans: 他经常去图书馆。

examples.sentence: My brother frequently goes to the library to borrow books.
examples.trans: 我哥哥经常去图书馆借书。

examples.sentence: Buses run frequently on this seaside road in July.
examples.trans: 七月这海滨路上的公交很频繁。

examples.sentence: Tourists who photograph frequently may notice the place less.
examples.trans: 频繁拍照的游客可能更少注意这个地方。

examples.sentence: Flights that are cancelled frequently teach you to read a second timetable.
examples.trans: 频繁取消的航班教你去读第二张时间表。

examples.sentence: A right that is frequently delayed is a right that is being quietly rewritten.
examples.trans: 频繁被推迟的权利，是正在被悄悄改写的权利。

crowds.usageZh: 名词复数：crowds of people；avoid the crowds。单数 crowd。

examples.sentence: Holiday markets are full of crowds.
examples.trans: 假日市场挤满人群。

examples.sentence: During the holiday, shopping centers are always full of crowds.
examples.trans: 假日期间购物中心总是挤满人群。

examples.sentence: I leave early to miss the crowds at the gate.
examples.trans: 我早走，好避开门口的人群。

examples.sentence: Crowds are a design problem: hours, tickets, and shade.
examples.trans: 人群是设计问题：时间、票和荫凉。

examples.sentence: Managing crowds without humiliating visitors is a civic skill.
examples.trans: 管理人群而不羞辱访客，是一种公民技能。

examples.sentence: The crowds that make a place rich can make the people who live there poor in time.
examples.trans: 让一个地方变富的人群，可以让住在那里的人在时间上变穷。

queues.usageZh: 名词复数（英式）：long queues。美式 lines。动词 queue。

examples.sentence: We waited in long queues for ice cream.
examples.trans: 我们排长队等冰淇淋。

examples.sentence: We had to wait in long queues to buy tickets for the new movie.
examples.trans: 我们得排长队买新电影的票。

examples.sentence: Fair queues beat a smile that lets friends cut in.
examples.trans: 公平的队列胜过让朋友插队的微笑。

examples.sentence: Queues at a border are a map of whose time is treated as cheap.
examples.trans: 边境的队列是一张地图：谁的时间被当作廉价。

examples.sentence: Digital queues can hide the same old privilege behind a number.
examples.trans: 数字队列可以把同样的旧特权藏在一个号码后面。

examples.sentence: A city that cannot design humane queues has not designed tourism; it has designed waiting.
examples.trans: 无法设计人道队列的城市，设计的不是旅游，是等待。

reduce.usageZh: 及物动词：reduce waste / risk / crowds。名词 reduction。

examples.sentence: Please reduce the volume of the speaker.
examples.trans: 请把音箱音量减小。

examples.sentence: We should reduce the use of plastic bags to protect the environment.
examples.trans: 我们应减少塑料袋使用以保护环境。

examples.sentence: Leaving on a weekday can reduce the queues at the gate.
examples.trans: 工作日出发可以减少门口的队列。

examples.sentence: To reduce harm at a site, cap the daily tickets.
examples.trans: 要减少对一处遗址的伤害，就限制每日票数。

examples.sentence: Airlines reduce prices by moving costs onto the people who clean the cabin.
examples.trans: 航司靠把成本转给清洁机舱的人来降价。

examples.sentence: Cities that reduce night transport reduce who may work the late shift.
examples.trans: 减少夜间交通的城市，是在减少谁可以上晚班。

unpopular.usageZh: 形容词，popular 的反义词：be unpopular with。表示不受欢迎的。

examples.sentence: The cold bus stop is unpopular in winter.
examples.trans: 冬天这个冷公交站不受欢迎。

examples.sentence: An unpopular rule can still be a fair one.
examples.trans: 不受欢迎的规则仍可能是公平的。

examples.sentence: Unpopular hours at a museum are a gift to anyone who hates crowds.
examples.trans: 博物馆不受欢迎的时段，是给讨厌人群者的礼物。

examples.sentence: An unpopular tax that funds the train is still a public good.
examples.trans: 为火车拨款的不受欢迎的税，仍是公共物品。

examples.sentence: Leaders delay unpopular limits on visitors until the street breaks.
examples.trans: 领导把不受欢迎的访客限制推迟到街道崩坏。

examples.sentence: The most unpopular destinations of one decade become the overcrowded ones of the next.
examples.trans: 十年里最不受欢迎的目的地，会成为下一个十年过度拥挤的那些。

mainstream.usageZh: 名词，常作定语：mainstream culture / media。break away from the mainstream。

examples.sentence: This shop does not follow the mainstream.
examples.trans: 这家店不跟随主流。

examples.sentence: Her fashion style is unique and never follows the mainstream trends.
examples.trans: 她的时尚风格独特，从不跟随主流趋势。

examples.sentence: A small island path is not in the mainstream, and that is the point.
examples.trans: 小岛上的小路不在主流里，而这正是重点。

examples.sentence: Mainstream guidebooks flatten a city into ten photographs.
examples.trans: 主流指南把一座城市压成十张照片。

examples.sentence: To leave the mainstream is not automatically to be ethical.
examples.trans: 离开主流并不自动等于道德。

examples.sentence: When the mainstream discovers a village, the village must decide what to sell and what to keep.
examples.trans: 当主流发现一座村庄，村庄必须决定卖什么、留什么。

unusual.usageZh: 形容词：an unusual rock；It is unusual to...。反义词 usual。

examples.sentence: We found an unusual shell on the sand.
examples.trans: 我们在沙上发现一只不寻常的贝壳。

examples.sentence: The scientist discovered an unusual rock formation deep in the cave.
examples.trans: 科学家在洞穴深处发现了不寻常的岩石构造。

examples.sentence: An unusual itinerary needs extra time and a calmer temper.
examples.trans: 不寻常的行程需要额外时间和更平静的脾气。

examples.sentence: It is unusual to travel without a phone, and that unusual week can repair attention.
examples.trans: 不带手机旅行不寻常，而那不寻常的一周能修好注意力。

examples.sentence: An unusual request at a border is often a right wearing a rare accent.
examples.trans: 边境上不寻常的请求，常常是带着罕见口音的权利。

examples.sentence: What a brochure calls unusual is often ordinary to the people who live there.
examples.trans: 手册称为不寻常的，对住在那里的人常常是平常。

expectations.usageZh: 名词常用复数：meet / high expectations。动词 expect。

examples.sentence: My expectations for the picnic were simple.
examples.trans: 我对野餐的期望很简单。

examples.sentence: The new product failed to meet the customers' high expectations.
examples.trans: 新产品未能满足顾客的高期望。

examples.sentence: Low expectations of a small town can be a kind of insult.
examples.trans: 对小镇的低期望可以是一种侮辱。

examples.sentence: Name your expectations before you name the disappointment.
examples.trans: 先点名期望，再点名失望。

examples.sentence: Holiday expectations are a script written by ads.
examples.trans: 假期期望是广告写好的脚本。

examples.sentence: Public expectations of tourism income can trap a coast in a single season.
examples.trans: 对旅游收入的公共期望，可以把海岸困在单一季节里。

advantages.usageZh: 名词常用复数：advantages of；have advantages over。反义词 disadvantages。

examples.sentence: One of the advantages of a bike is silence.
examples.trans: 自行车的优点之一是安静。

examples.sentence: One of the main advantages of online learning is its flexibility.
examples.trans: 在线学习的主要优点之一是灵活。

examples.sentence: The advantages of a slow train include the window.
examples.trans: 慢火车的优点包括那扇窗。

examples.sentence: List the advantages of staying, not only of leaving.
examples.trans: 列出留下的优点，而不只是离开的。

examples.sentence: Comparative advantages of a port change when the climate changes.
examples.trans: 气候改变时，港口的比较优势也会改变。

examples.sentence: Advertising sells advantages; a contract should sell the delays.
examples.trans: 广告卖优点；合同应当卖延误。

stressful.usageZh: 形容词：a stressful job / journey。find sth stressful。名词 stress。

examples.sentence: The crowded station felt stressful.
examples.trans: 拥挤的车站让人感到有压力。

examples.sentence: Preparing for the final exam can be a very stressful period for many people.
examples.trans: 备考期末对许多人可以是压力很大的时期。

examples.sentence: A stressful connection is not a holiday, even if the photos look bright.
examples.trans: 压力大的转乘不是假期，即便照片看起来明亮。

examples.sentence: A stressful itinerary is often an ego wearing a suitcase.
examples.trans: 压力大的行程常常是穿着行李箱的自我。

examples.sentence: Airports are stressful by design: too few chairs, too many screens.
examples.trans: 机场在设计上就是有压力的：椅子太少，屏幕太多。

examples.sentence: Calling care work stressful without funding it is a speech, not a policy.
examples.trans: 称照料工作有压力却不拨款，是演讲，不是政策。

backpacker.usageZh: 可数名词：budget backpacker。动词 backpack。

examples.sentence: The young backpacker asked for a cheap bed.
examples.trans: 年轻背包客要一张便宜的床。

examples.sentence: As a budget backpacker, she prefers to stay in hostels and cook her own meals.
examples.trans: 作为预算背包客，她更愿住旅舍并自己做饭。

examples.sentence: A backpacker still leaves a trace, however light the bag.
examples.trans: 背包客仍会留下痕迹，无论包多轻。

examples.sentence: The backpacker myth can hide a credit card and a flight home.
examples.trans: 背包客神话可以藏起一张信用卡和回家的航班。

examples.sentence: Host towns need the backpacker pound and also a night of quiet.
examples.trans: 接待小镇需要背包客的钱，也需要一夜安静。

examples.sentence: A backpacker trail that becomes a brand will price out the next backpacker.
examples.trans: 变成品牌的背包客小径，会把下一个背包客挤出去。

reservations.usageZh: 名词常用复数：make / cancel reservations。也可指保留意见 have reservations。本题取预订。

examples.sentence: We made dinner reservations for seven.
examples.trans: 我们订了七点的晚餐。

examples.sentence: We made dinner reservations at the restaurant for 7 o'clock.
examples.trans: 我们在餐馆订了七点的晚餐。

examples.sentence: No reservations means a queue, so we ate next door.
examples.trans: 没有预订意味着排队，所以我们在隔壁吃了。

examples.sentence: Refund rules hide inside the small print of reservations.
examples.trans: 退款规则藏在预订的小号字里。

examples.sentence: Platforms sell reservations they do not own, which is a trust problem.
examples.trans: 平台出售它们并不拥有的预订，这是信任问题。

examples.sentence: A city that auctions reservations for public parks has already chosen a class of visitor.
examples.trans: 拍卖公园预订的城市，已经选好了哪一类访客。

comfortable.usageZh: 形容词：a comfortable chair；feel comfortable。比较级 more comfortable。

examples.sentence: This seat is comfortable enough for a nap.
examples.trans: 这个座位舒服到可以打盹。

examples.sentence: After a long walk, it felt great to sit in a comfortable armchair.
examples.trans: 长走之后坐进舒适的扶手椅感觉很好。

examples.sentence: A comfortable bus can still be a late one.
examples.trans: 舒适的公交仍可能晚点。

examples.sentence: Make the waiting room comfortable if you cannot make it short.
examples.trans: 如果不能让等候变短，就让等候室舒适。

examples.sentence: Comfortable tourism is often someone else's uncomfortable shift.
examples.trans: 舒适的旅游常常是别人不舒适的班次。

examples.sentence: A comfortable class will defend a view and call it a right.
examples.trans: 舒适的阶级会捍卫一种视野并称之为权利。

pros.usageZh: 名词常用复数，常与 cons 成对：pros and cons。表示优点。

examples.sentence: List the pros of the cheap ticket first.
examples.trans: 先列出廉价票的优点。

examples.sentence: Before making a decision, we should carefully consider all the pros and cons.
examples.trans: 做决定前应仔细考虑所有利弊。

examples.sentence: The pros of a night train include sleep and a morning city.
examples.trans: 夜火车的优点包括睡眠和一座早晨的城市。

examples.sentence: Write the pros in numbers, not only in adjectives.
examples.trans: 用数字写优点，而不只用形容词。

examples.sentence: The pros of a mega-event rarely include the cleaners' names.
examples.trans: 大型活动的优点很少包括清洁工的名字。

examples.sentence: Consultations that list only the pros are advertisements wearing a public hat.
examples.trans: 只列优点的咨询是戴着公共帽子的广告。

cons.usageZh: 名词常用复数，与 pros 相对：the cons of living downtown。

examples.sentence: One of the cons is the long walk.
examples.trans: 缺点之一是要走很久。

examples.sentence: One of the major cons of living downtown is the high cost of rent.
examples.trans: 住在市中心的主要缺点之一是租金高。

examples.sentence: The cons of a tight itinerary include no time to get lost kindly.
examples.trans: 紧行程的缺点包括没有时间友善地迷路。

examples.sentence: Name the cons of the shortcut before you sell the speed.
examples.trans: 在出售速度之前先点名捷径的缺点。

examples.sentence: The cons of cheap flights include a climate bill someone else will pay.
examples.trans: 廉价航班的缺点包括别人将支付的气候账单。

examples.sentence: A fair dossier prints the cons in the same type size as the ribbon cutting.
examples.trans: 公平的档案用与剪彩同样的字号印刷缺点。

marvellous.usageZh: 形容词（英式拼写）：极好的、令人惊叹的。美式 marvelous。

examples.sentence: We had a marvellous day at the lake.
examples.trans: 我们在湖边度过了极好的一天。

examples.sentence: We had a marvellous time at the concert last night.
examples.trans: 我们昨晚在音乐会上度过了极好的时光。

examples.sentence: The guide was marvellous, and she named the birds without showing off.
examples.trans: 导游极好，她点出鸟名却不炫耀。

examples.sentence: A marvellous view does not excuse a cruel timetable for staff.
examples.trans: 极好的景色不能为员工残忍的时间表开脱。

examples.sentence: What a brochure calls marvellous may be someone else's workplace.
examples.trans: 手册称为极好的，可能是别人的工作场所。

examples.sentence: A marvellous restoration funded by tickets still owes a sentence to the people moved out.
examples.trans: 由门票资助的极好修复，仍欠一句对被迁走的人的话。

journey.usageZh: 可数名词，强调过程，常指较长路程。与 trip / travel 有细微差别。

examples.sentence: The journey to grandma's house takes two hours.
examples.trans: 去奶奶家的旅程要两小时。

examples.sentence: The journey from childhood to adulthood is full of challenges and discoveries.
examples.trans: 从童年到成年的旅程充满挑战和发现。

examples.sentence: A slow journey can be the point of the holiday.
examples.trans: 一段慢旅程可以是假期的重点。

examples.sentence: The journey is not a metaphor when the train is late and the baby is hungry.
examples.trans: 火车晚点、婴儿饥饿时，旅程不是比喻。

examples.sentence: Every journey leaves a carbon line, however poetic the window.
examples.trans: 每一段旅程都留下一条碳线，无论窗子多有诗意。

examples.sentence: A nation's journey stories decide whose waiting is called patience and whose is called delay.
examples.trans: 一个国家的旅程故事，决定谁的等待被称为耐心，谁的被称为延误。

attract.usageZh: 及物动词：attract sb / tourists。名词 attraction。

examples.sentence: Bright flowers attract bees and visitors.
examples.trans: 鲜亮的花吸引蜜蜂和访客。

examples.sentence: The bright colors of the flowers attract many butterflies to the garden.
examples.trans: 花的鲜亮颜色把许多蝴蝶吸引到花园。

examples.sentence: Cheap tickets attract crowds that the path cannot hold.
examples.trans: 廉价票吸引小路盛不下的人群。

examples.sentence: A poster can attract a visitor; only a wage can keep a guide.
examples.trans: 海报能吸引访客；只有工资能留住导游。

examples.sentence: Lights that attract nightlife also attract a noise complaint at 2 a.m.
examples.trans: 吸引夜生活的灯，也会在凌晨两点吸引噪音投诉。

examples.sentence: Policies that attract capital without attracting housing will attract anger next.
examples.trans: 吸引资本却不吸引住房的政策，接下来会吸引愤怒。

treeless.usageZh: 形容词：tree + -less，描述没有树木的地貌。

examples.sentence: The treeless hill looked wide and empty.
examples.trans: 没有树木的小山看起来开阔而空。

examples.sentence: The treeless plateau offered an unobstructed view of the starry night sky.
examples.trans: 无树的高原提供了星空无遮挡的视野。

examples.sentence: A treeless car park is a choice, not a climate.
examples.trans: 没有树木的停车场是一种选择，不是一种气候。

examples.sentence: Treeless streets run hotter, which is a public-health fact.
examples.trans: 没有树木的街道更热，这是公共卫生事实。

examples.sentence: A treeless waterfront sells the view and spends the shade.
examples.trans: 没有树木的滨水区出售景色，花掉荫凉。

examples.sentence: Maps of treeless neighbourhoods often match maps of who was not invited to the plan.
examples.trans: 没有树木的街区地图，常常与谁未被邀请进规划的地图重合。

wildlife.usageZh: 不可数集合名词：protect / observe wildlife。

examples.sentence: We watched wildlife from a quiet path.
examples.trans: 我们从安静的小路上观看野生动物。

examples.sentence: The national park is famous for its rich and diverse wildlife.
examples.trans: 国家公园以丰富多样的野生动物闻名。

examples.sentence: Feeding wildlife is a kindness that can become a harm.
examples.trans: 投喂野生动物是一种可能变成伤害的善意。

examples.sentence: Wildlife tourism must leave the animals a place with no audience.
examples.trans: 野生动物旅游必须给动物留一个没有观众的地方。

examples.sentence: A selfie with wildlife is often a record of a boundary crossed.
examples.trans: 与野生动物的自拍常常是越过边界的记录。

examples.sentence: When wildlife declines, a destination is selling a ghost of itself.
examples.trans: 当野生动物减少，目的地是在出售自己的鬼魂。

passengers.usageZh: 可数名词，passenger 的复数。train / bus / plane passengers。

examples.sentence: All passengers need a ticket in their hand.
examples.trans: 所有乘客手里都需要一张票。

examples.sentence: All passengers must fasten their seat belts before the plane takes off.
examples.trans: 飞机起飞前所有乘客必须系好安全带。

examples.sentence: Kind passengers make room without being asked.
examples.trans: 友善的乘客不用被请就会让出空间。

examples.sentence: Passengers are not cargo, however efficient the timetable.
examples.trans: 无论时间表多高效，乘客都不是货物。

examples.sentence: A delay that strands passengers is a labour story as well as a weather story.
examples.trans: 困住乘客的延误既是天气故事，也是劳动故事。

examples.sentence: Rights of passengers at a border are a test of a country's self-image.
examples.trans: 边境上乘客的权利，是一个国家自我形象的测试。

sightseeing.usageZh: 不可数：go sightseeing；do some sightseeing。也作定语 sightseeing tour。

examples.sentence: We went sightseeing after breakfast.
examples.trans: 早饭后我们去观光。

examples.sentence: We spent the morning sightseeing and visited two ancient temples.
examples.trans: 我们上午观光，参观了两座古庙。

examples.sentence: Too much sightseeing in one day turns a city into a checklist.
examples.trans: 一天里太多观光会把城市变成清单。

examples.sentence: Sightseeing that never sits down will not hear a street.
examples.trans: 从不坐下的观光听不见一条街。

examples.sentence: Paid sightseeing buses can hide the walk that would have taught you the scale.
examples.trans: 付费观光巴士可以藏起本可以教你尺度的步行。

examples.sentence: When sightseeing becomes the only legal use of a square, residents become scenery.
examples.trans: 当观光成为广场唯一合法用途时，居民就变成风景。

opportunities.usageZh: 名词常用复数：have / miss / seize opportunities。单数 opportunity。意为机会。

examples.sentence: Travel can give students new opportunities.
examples.trans: 旅行可以给学生新机会。

examples.sentence: The trip offered opportunities to practise English with kind strangers.
examples.trans: 这次旅行为与友善陌生人练习英语提供了机会。

examples.sentence: Missed opportunities often look like a bus you almost caught.
examples.trans: 错过的机会看起来常常像你差点赶上的公交。

examples.sentence: Equal opportunities to travel still require a passport that works.
examples.trans: 平等的旅行机会仍需要一本管用的护照。

examples.sentence: Internships abroad are opportunities wearing a class accent.
examples.trans: 海外实习是带着阶级口音的机会。

examples.sentence: A city that sells opportunities in tourism must also sell winter work.
examples.trans: 在旅游中出售机会的城市，也必须出售冬季的工作。

world view.usageZh: 名词短语：世界观。也可 worldview。

examples.sentence: Books can change a child's world view.
examples.trans: 书能改变孩子的世界观。

examples.sentence: Reading books about different cultures can help broaden a person's world view.
examples.trans: 读不同文化的书有助于拓宽世界观。

examples.sentence: A week in a small town can still shift a world view.
examples.trans: 在小镇的一周仍可以移动世界观。

examples.sentence: A world view built only from airports is a brochure.
examples.trans: 只从机场建成的世界观是一本手册。

examples.sentence: Education that never leaves the district still owes students a wider world view.
examples.trans: 从不离开本区的教育，仍欠学生更宽的世界观。

examples.sentence: A national world view that cannot imagine other kitchens will fail at the first treaty.
examples.trans: 无法想象其他厨房的国家世界观，会在第一份条约上失败。

loved ones.usageZh: 名词短语：所爱之人、亲人。

examples.sentence: I miss my loved ones when I travel.
examples.trans: 旅行时我想念所爱的人。

examples.sentence: During the Spring Festival, people travel long distances to reunite with their loved ones.
examples.trans: 春节人们长途旅行与所爱之人团聚。

examples.sentence: Call your loved ones when the plane lands, even if you are tired.
examples.trans: 飞机降落就给所爱的人打电话，即使你累了。

examples.sentence: A policy that strands loved ones at a border is not a technical delay.
examples.trans: 把所爱之人困在边境的政策，不是技术性延误。

examples.sentence: Photos of loved ones in a wallet are a kind of passport too.
examples.trans: 钱包里所爱之人的照片也是一种护照。

examples.sentence: Care for loved ones is work, whether or not a ticket was purchased.
examples.trans: 照料所爱之人是工作，无论买没买票。

comparing to.usageZh: 课文搭配 comparing to，口语中常见；书面更常用 compared with / to。本单元保留该键。

examples.sentence: Comparing to last week, this train is quieter.
examples.trans: 和上周相比，这班火车更安静。

examples.sentence: Comparing to last year, my English vocabulary has improved a lot.
examples.trans: 和去年相比，我的英语词汇进步很多。

examples.sentence: Comparing to the map, the real hill is steeper.
examples.trans: 和地图相比，真的山更陡。

examples.sentence: Comparing to the brochure, the room was honest and small.
examples.trans: 和手册相比，房间诚实而小。

examples.sentence: Comparing to air travel, the night train wastes less of the morning.
examples.trans: 和飞机相比，夜火车少浪费早晨。

examples.sentence: Comparing to a GDP headline, a late bus is a small line that still decides a shift.
examples.trans: 和 GDP 标题相比，晚点的公交是仍能决定一个班次的小行字。

a bunch of.usageZh: 非正式数量短语：许多、一大堆。后接可数或有时不可数。

examples.sentence: She got a bunch of postcards from the trip.
examples.trans: 她从旅行中得到一大堆明信片。

examples.sentence: She received a bunch of messages from her friends on her birthday.
examples.trans: 生日那天她收到朋友一大堆短信。

examples.sentence: We packed a bunch of snacks and still bought more at the station.
examples.trans: 我们装了一大堆零食，在车站还是又买了。

examples.sentence: A bunch of likes is not a review of a place.
examples.trans: 一大堆点赞不是对一个地方的评论。

examples.sentence: A bunch of delayed trains is a system, not a coincidence.
examples.trans: 一大堆晚点火车是系统，不是巧合。

examples.sentence: A bunch of visas denied in a week is a policy you can count.
examples.trans: 一周内被拒的一大堆签证，是你可以数的政策。

away from.usageZh: 介词短语：远离。stay away from；far away from。

examples.sentence: The library is away from the noisy street.
examples.trans: 图书馆远离嘈杂的街道。

examples.sentence: The library is a quiet place away from the noise of the busy street.
examples.trans: 图书馆是远离闹市噪音的安静地方。

examples.sentence: We walked away from the crowds and found a cheaper lunch.
examples.trans: 我们离开人群，找到更便宜的午饭。

examples.sentence: A week away from email can still be work if you carry a boss in your head.
examples.trans: 远离邮件的一周，如果你脑子里仍带着老板，仍可能是工作。

examples.sentence: Housing away from the metro is a climate and a class fact.
examples.trans: 远离地铁的住房既是气候事实，也是阶级事实。

examples.sentence: A capital that sits away from the floodplain still votes on the floodplain's budget.
examples.trans: 远离洪泛区的首都，仍对洪泛区的预算投票。

go for.usageZh: 短语：去（做某事）；选择。go for a walk；go for the cheaper ticket。

examples.sentence: Let's go for a walk after dinner.
examples.trans: 晚饭后我们去散步吧。

examples.sentence: Let's go for a walk in the park after dinner to help with digestion.
examples.trans: 晚饭后去公园散步，帮助消化。

examples.sentence: I will go for the slow train even if it costs an hour.
examples.trans: 即使多花一小时，我也选择慢火车。

examples.sentence: Go for the hostel if you want names, not only a view.
examples.trans: 如果你想要名字而不只是景色，就选择旅舍。

examples.sentence: Voters go for the candidate who can say the word bus.
examples.trans: 选民选择能把“公交”这个词说出口的候选人。

examples.sentence: Cities that go for events over housing will go for crisis next.
examples.trans: 选择活动而非住房的城市，接下来会选择危机。

based on.usageZh: 过去分词短语：based on a true story / on data。

examples.sentence: The film is based on a diary.
examples.trans: 这部电影基于一本日记。

examples.sentence: The movie is based on a true story that happened in the 19th century.
examples.trans: 电影基于发生在19世纪的真实故事。

examples.sentence: Our plan is based on the last train, not on a wish.
examples.trans: 我们的计划基于末班车，不是基于愿望。

examples.sentence: Advice based on one viral trip is not a method.
examples.trans: 基于一次爆款旅行的建议不是方法。

examples.sentence: A visa decision based on a stereotype is still a decision with a body.
examples.trans: 基于刻板印象的签证决定，仍是带着身体的决定。

examples.sentence: Budgets based on last year's tourists will fail the first wet season.
examples.trans: 基于去年游客的预算，会在第一个雨季失败。

crowds of.usageZh: crowds of + 复数名词：成群的、大量的。

examples.sentence: Crowds of children waited at the gate.
examples.trans: 成群的孩子在门口等。

examples.sentence: During the holiday, crowds of tourists visit the Great Wall every day.
examples.trans: 假日每天都有成群游客参观长城。

examples.sentence: Crowds of phones rose at the same second, and the bird left.
examples.trans: 成群的手机在同一秒举起，鸟就离开了。

examples.sentence: Crowds of day-trippers can empty a bakery before noon.
examples.trans: 成群的一日游游客能在中午前掏空一家面包店。

examples.sentence: Managing crowds of cars is not the same as welcoming people.
examples.trans: 管理成群的汽车并不等于欢迎人。

examples.sentence: Crowds of capital arriving in a week can price out a street that took a century.
examples.trans: 一周内涌入的成群资本，可以给花了一个世纪的街道定价到挤出原居民。

trade it for.usageZh: trade A for B：用……交换。本键含代词 it，例句需保留 it。

examples.sentence: I would not trade it for a new bag.
examples.trans: 我不会用它换一个新包。

examples.sentence: I love my old bicycle so much that I wouldn't trade it for a new one.
examples.trans: 我那么爱旧自行车，不会用它换新的。

examples.sentence: The view was noisy; I would still not trade it for a mall.
examples.trans: 景色很吵；我仍不愿用它换商场。

examples.sentence: Do not trade it for a faster route if the faster route erases a neighbourhood.
examples.trans: 如果更快的路线抹掉一个街区，就不要用它去换。

examples.sentence: A city that will trade it for a stadium should say who loses the park.
examples.trans: 愿用它换体育场的城市，应当说出谁失去公园。

examples.sentence: Memory is not a currency: you cannot trade it for a cleaner myth.
examples.trans: 记忆不是货币：你不能用它换一个更干净的迷思。

break time.usageZh: 名词短语：休息时间。a short break time between classes。

examples.sentence: We have a short break time at ten.
examples.trans: 我们十点有一小段休息时间。

examples.sentence: Students usually have a short break time between classes to relax and prepare for the next lesson.
examples.trans: 学生通常在课间有短暂休息时间，放松并为下一课做准备。

examples.sentence: Use the break time to drink water, not only to check the phone.
examples.trans: 用休息时间喝水，而不只是看手机。

examples.sentence: Drivers need break time written into the contract, not into a slogan.
examples.trans: 司机需要写进合同的休息时间，而不是写进口号的。

examples.sentence: A tour without break time is a factory wearing sunglasses.
examples.trans: 没有休息时间的游览是戴着墨镜的工厂。

examples.sentence: Denying break time at a border is a way of saying whose body may tire.
examples.trans: 在边境剥夺休息时间，是在说谁的身体可以疲倦。

break away from.usageZh: 短语动词：摆脱、脱离传统或控制。

examples.sentence: I want to break away from my old timetable.
examples.trans: 我想摆脱旧时间表。

examples.sentence: To achieve true innovation, sometimes you must break away from traditional methods.
examples.trans: 要真正创新，有时必须摆脱传统方法。

examples.sentence: We broke away from the tour group and found a quieter square.
examples.trans: 我们脱离旅行团，找到更安静的广场。

examples.sentence: Break away from the five-star script if you want to hear a city.
examples.trans: 若想听见一座城市，就摆脱五星脚本。

examples.sentence: A region that cannot break away from a single crop will travel poorly when the price falls.
examples.trans: 无法摆脱单一作物的地区，价格下跌时会走得很差。

examples.sentence: Young people who break away from a forced route still need a legal road, not only courage.
examples.trans: 摆脱被迫路线的年轻人仍需要合法的路，而不只是勇气。

turn out to be.usageZh: turn out to be 表示结果是、证明是。过去式 turned out to be。

examples.sentence: The shortcut turned out to be longer.
examples.trans: 捷径结果更长。

examples.sentence: The weather forecast predicted rain, but the day turned out to be sunny and perfect for the picnic.
examples.trans: 预报说有雨，那天结果却晴朗，很适合野餐。

examples.sentence: The cheap hotel turned out to be kind and clean.
examples.trans: 便宜旅馆结果友善又干净。

examples.sentence: The delay turned out to be a staffing choice, not a storm.
examples.trans: 延误结果是人手选择，不是风暴。

examples.sentence: A viral paradise can turn out to be a village without a clinic.
examples.trans: 爆款天堂结果可能是没有诊所的村庄。

examples.sentence: Reforms that turn out to be rebranding will be read as contempt.
examples.trans: 结果只是换品牌的改革，会被读成轻蔑。

used to be.usageZh: used to be 表示过去曾经是、现在已不是。后接名词或形容词。

examples.sentence: This park used to be a noisy factory.
examples.trans: 这座公园曾经是嘈杂的工厂。

examples.sentence: This quiet park used to be a noisy factory many years ago.
examples.trans: 这座安静公园许多年前曾经是嘈杂工厂。

examples.sentence: The harbour used to be full of fishing boats, not cafes.
examples.trans: 港口曾经满是渔船，不是咖啡馆。

examples.sentence: The street used to be a market until the rent arrived.
examples.trans: 这条街曾经是市场，直到租金到来。

examples.sentence: What used to be a right of way is now a ticketed view.
examples.trans: 曾经是通行权的，现在是售票的景色。

examples.sentence: A coastline that used to be a commons will not become one again without a law.
examples.trans: 曾经是公地的海岸，没有法律不会再变成公地。

first of all.usageZh: 连接语：首先。用于列举理由或步骤。

examples.sentence: First of all, pack water and a map.
examples.trans: 首先，带上水和地图。

examples.sentence: First of all, let me thank everyone for coming to this meeting today.
examples.trans: 首先，感谢大家今天来参加会议。

examples.sentence: First of all, check the last bus, then check the cafe.
examples.trans: 首先查末班车，再查咖啡馆。

examples.sentence: First of all, name who pays; then name who enjoys the view.
examples.trans: 首先点名谁付钱；再点名谁享受景色。

examples.sentence: First of all, a timetable is a moral document.
examples.trans: 首先，时间表是一份道德文件。

examples.sentence: First of all, a border is a sentence about bodies, not about brochures.
examples.trans: 首先，边境是关于身体的句子，不是关于手册的。

compared to.usageZh: compared to / with 表示与……相比。注意与 comparing to 的形式差别。

examples.sentence: This bag is lighter compared to mine.
examples.trans: 这个包和我的相比更轻。

examples.sentence: Life in a small town is much quieter compared to life in a big city.
examples.trans: 小镇生活和大城市相比安静得多。

examples.sentence: The night train is kinder compared to a 5 a.m. flight.
examples.trans: 和凌晨五点的航班相比，夜火车更友善。

examples.sentence: Wages look different compared to the rent by the station.
examples.trans: 和车站旁的租金相比，工资看起来不一样。

examples.sentence: Emissions look modest compared to a headline, and huge compared to a budget.
examples.trans: 排放和标题相比显得谦虚，和预算相比却巨大。

examples.sentence: A right delayed compared to a neighbour's is a right denied in slow motion.
examples.trans: 和邻居相比被推迟的权利，是慢动作中被拒绝的权利。

from door to door.usageZh: from door to door 可指挨家挨户，也可指门到门的直达运送。

examples.sentence: The postman walks from door to door in the rain.
examples.trans: 邮递员雨中挨家挨户走。

examples.sentence: The courier service promises delivery from door to door within 24 hours.
examples.trans: 快递承诺24小时内门到门送达。

examples.sentence: A kind neighbour went from door to door with extra umbrellas.
examples.trans: 友善的邻居拿着多余的伞挨家挨户去。

examples.sentence: Tourism that sells from door to door pickup still hides the driver's unpaid wait.
examples.trans: 出售门到门接送的旅游，仍藏起司机无酬的等待。

examples.sentence: Campaigns that go from door to door still need a language the street uses.
examples.trans: 挨家挨户的竞选仍需要街上使用的语言。

examples.sentence: A census that cannot go from door to door will invent the missing people as a round number.
examples.trans: 无法挨家挨户走的普查，会把失踪的人发明成一个整数。

worth mentioning.usageZh: It is worth mentioning that... 表示值得一提。worth + doing。

examples.sentence: It is worth mentioning the free water at the gate.
examples.trans: 门口的免费水值得一提。

examples.sentence: It is worth mentioning that all participants showed great teamwork during the competition.
examples.trans: 值得一提的是，比赛中所有参与者都表现出色的团队合作。

examples.sentence: The quiet courtyard is worth mentioning in any honest review.
examples.trans: 安静的院子在任何诚实评论里都值得一提。

examples.sentence: The night bus is worth mentioning because it decides who can work late.
examples.trans: 夜班车值得一提，因为它决定谁能工作到晚。

examples.sentence: A leak in the roof is worth mentioning before the view.
examples.trans: 屋顶漏水值得在景色之前一提。

examples.sentence: What is worth mentioning in a treaty is often the clause in the smallest type.
examples.trans: 条约里值得一提的，常常是最小号字体里的条款。

take part in.usageZh: take part in + 活动：参加。第三人称 takes part in。

examples.sentence: I want to take part in the school trip.
examples.trans: 我想参加学校旅行。

examples.sentence: Over fifty countries will take part in the international science fair next month.
examples.trans: 五十多个国家将参加下月的国际科学博览会。

examples.sentence: Tourists who take part in a festival should learn the rules first.
examples.trans: 参加节日的游客应先学习规则。

examples.sentence: Residents must be able to take part in the plan that will change their street.
examples.trans: 居民必须能参加将改变他们街道的规划。

examples.sentence: Who may take part in a consultation is already the decision.
examples.trans: 谁可以参加咨询，已经是那个决定。

examples.sentence: A democracy in which only the mobile can take part in culture is a gated one.
examples.trans: 只有行动方便的人才能参加文化的民主，是一座有门的民主。

a lot of.usageZh: a lot of + 可数或不可数：许多。比 lots of 稍正式一点。

examples.sentence: The bag holds a lot of snacks for the train.
examples.trans: 包里为火车装了许多零食。

examples.sentence: The library has a lot of useful books for your research project.
examples.trans: 图书馆有许多对研究项目有用的书。

examples.sentence: A lot of noise at dawn is not a charming local custom.
examples.trans: 黎明的许多噪音不是迷人的地方习俗。

examples.sentence: A lot of visitors can still be too many for one well.
examples.trans: 许多访客对一口井来说仍可能太多。

examples.sentence: A lot of carbon hides in a cheap weekend.
examples.trans: 许多碳藏在一个廉价周末里。

examples.sentence: A lot of consent forms do not equal consent if the language is a trap.
examples.trans: 如果语言是陷阱，许多同意书并不等于同意。

pros and cons.usageZh: 固定短语：优点和缺点。weigh the pros and cons。

examples.sentence: We listed the pros and cons of the two hotels.
examples.trans: 我们列出了两家酒店的利弊。

examples.sentence: Before making a decision, it's wise to consider all the pros and cons carefully.
examples.trans: 做决定前仔细考虑所有利弊是明智的。

examples.sentence: The pros and cons of a night bus include sleep and safety.
examples.trans: 夜班车的利弊包括睡眠和安全。

examples.sentence: Write the pros and cons in the same font size.
examples.trans: 用同样的字号写利弊。

examples.sentence: The pros and cons of a mega-event rarely include the cleaners.
examples.trans: 大型活动的利弊很少包括清洁工。

examples.sentence: A public hearing that hides the cons while inflating the pros is not a hearing.
examples.trans: 隐藏缺点却夸大优点的公开听证不是听证。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时（经历/持续）及 since / for / already / yet / have been able to
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect for life experience and unfinished time
grammar.usage:
现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词，把过去发生的事与现在联系起来。
用法一：到现在为止的经历（ever / never / before）。
用法二：从过去持续到现在（since + 点时间 / for + 一段时间）。
否定：have/has not；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词。
初中：since 与 for 不要混；不规则动词用过去分词，不是过去式。
高中：现在完成进行时 have been doing 强调不间断；短暂动词（go/buy）在肯定句中不宜与 for 连用表示持续；对比一般过去时（有明确过去时间状语 yesterday/in 2019 时用过去时）。already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
forms: S + have/has + V-ed + since + 时间点
S + have/has + V-ed + for + 时段
have been doing（完成进行） / have been able to
notes: since 接时间点，for 接一段时间。
有明确过去时间（yesterday）时用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。
第三人称单数用 has，不是 have。
过去分词不要写成过去式（has wrote → has written）。
already 通常不与否定连用，否定用 yet。

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经做完作业了。

examples.en: She has lived here since 2019.
examples.cn: 她从2019年起就住在这里。

examples.en: We have been influenced by our families since birth.
examples.cn: 自出生以来，我们就一直受到家庭的影响。

examples.en: He has already reached out to three mentors this term.
examples.cn: 这学期他已经联系了三位导师。

examples.en: The team has not yet pinned down the exact cause of the delay.
examples.cn: 团队尚未确定延误的确切原因。

examples.en: Public debate has become more fragmented over the past decade.
examples.cn: 过去十年里，公共讨论变得更加碎片化。

exercises.q: I ______ my lunch already.
exercises.explain: already 常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: She ______ (finish) her homework.
exercises.explain: 第三人称 has + 过去分词。

exercises.q: “I have seen the film.” 表示到现在为止的经历。
改写：I finished the book. I still remember it well. → 用现在完成时强调结果。
改错：He have cleaned the room.
______ you ever visited the museum?
Tom isn't hungry because he ______ dinner.
exercises.explain: have dinner 的完成时 has had。

exercises.q: We ______ friends since primary school.
My dad ______ to Beijing, so he is not at home.
exercises.explain: has gone 表示去了还没回。

exercises.q: ______ they (play) football today?
I ______ (not do) my maths yet.
疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。
改为疑问：They have arrived.
改为否定：I have seen that app.
exercises.answer: I have not/haven't seen that app.

exercises.q: 改错：Have she ever tried sushi?
Lucy ______ English for six years.
Jack ______ (not visit) his grandpa yet this month.
有 for six years 时不能只用一般过去时表示仍在继续。
用 for 改写：She began the piano in 2018 and still plays.
exercises.answer: She has played the piano for ... years. / She has played the piano since 2018.

exercises.q: 改错：She has learned English since six years.
exercises.answer: She has learned English for six years.

exercises.q: ______ the team started the project yet?
I ______ this city before, so I can be your guide.
He ______ already ______ the problem.
exercises.explain: already 在 has 与过去分词之间。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ in this club?
______ you (read) the tips I sent?
We ______ (never see) such a huge library.
exercises.explain: never 放在 have 与过去分词之间。

exercises.q: 改为疑问：The coach has arrived.
改为完成时：I never ate sushi (到现在为止)。
改错：Have the news arrived?
yet 可以放在句尾。
We ______ by our families since birth.
exercises.explain: 完成时被动 have been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: I ______ (not figure) out my direction yet.
现在完成时可以用于被动。
改写：They started influencing me at birth and still do.
exercises.answer: I have been influenced since birth. / They have influenced me since birth.

exercises.q: 改错：I have been influence by my mentors.
exercises.answer: I have been influenced by my mentors.

exercises.q: She ______ already ______ a vague sense into a clear plan.
______ you ______ insight into your values?
No one but you ______ what you really believe in.
exercises.explain: no one 用 has。也可 is defining，但完成时强调到目前为止。

exercises.q: The process ______ not ______ stable yet.
He has already ______ (adopt) a new pace of work.
They ______ (broaden) their horizons since they began to travel.
改为完成时：She turned the vague idea into a plan (结果仍在)。
exercises.answer: She has turned the vague idea into a plan.

exercises.q: 用 since 连接：I met her in 2016. I still know her well.
exercises.answer: I have known her since I met her in 2016. / I have known her since 2016.

exercises.q: 改错：She have already pin down the topic.
exercises.answer: She has already pinned down the topic.

exercises.q: already 强调“已经发生”。
Researchers ______ several aspects of identity so far.
options: explored last night only as past
exercises.explain: so far 是完成时标志。

exercises.q: The committee ______ (not pin) down a definition yet.
so far / up to now 通常配现在完成时。
用 so far 改写：They started the survey and it continues.
exercises.answer: They have collected ... so far. / They have been conducting the survey so far.

exercises.q: 改错：So far they didn't find a stable pattern.
exercises.answer: So far they haven't found a stable pattern.

exercises.q: She ______ to three mentors this term.
exercises.explain: this term 未结束，常用完成时。

exercises.q: How many times ______ he ______ the same mistake?
I ______ able to keep pace with the reading load.
options: was able this morning as finished past

exercises.q: Since the policy ______, complaints have dropped.
We ______ (already adopt) the new method.
She has ______ (underestimate) the difficulty twice already.
未结束的时间状语（this week/term）常用完成时。
改为完成时：She reached out to a mentor this term (仍相关)。
exercises.answer: She has reached out to a mentor this term.

exercises.q: 用完成时提问次数：He was late three times (到现在)。
exercises.answer: How many times has he been late?

exercises.q: 改错：I have reached out to him yesterday.
exercises.answer: I reached out to him yesterday.

exercises.q: Public trust ______ over the past decade.
options: eroded in 1990 as a finished year
exercises.explain: over the past ... 配完成时。

exercises.q: The platform ______ (not yet address) the discrimination complaint.
exercises.answer: has not yet addressed/hasn't yet addressed

exercises.q: over the last few years 是完成时标志。
改写：The app launched in 2016 and users still report bugs.
exercises.answer: Users have reported bugs since 2016. / The app has had bugs since 2016.

exercises.q: 改错：Over the past decade the firm made a profit every year and still does, so we use only past tense.
exercises.answer: Over the past decade the firm has made a profit every year.

exercises.q: Critics ______ that the headline misled the audience.
She ______ on the same tragedy for months; it is time to seek help.
Nothing ______ more crucial than staying in touch with honest friends.
Once you ______ a sincere compliment, it cannot be taken back.
exercises.explain: Once you have done = 一旦已经。

exercises.q: Several studies ______ (show) a link between isolation and fatigue.
They ______ (conduct) face-to-face interviews all week.
改写：Three papers reported the same pattern (仍有效)。
exercises.answer: Three papers have reported the same pattern.

exercises.q: 用完成进行改写：He started editing at dawn and is still editing.
exercises.answer: He has been editing since dawn.

exercises.q: 改错：Researchers have showed a clear pattern.
exercises.answer: Researchers have shown a clear pattern.

exercises.q: 研究综述常用现在完成时引出已有文献。
Attention ______ increasingly fragmented since smartphones became ubiquitous.
options: became in a closed past with no present link

exercises.q: Regulators ______ (not yet pin) down a workable standard.
exercises.answer: have not yet pinned/haven't yet pinned

exercises.q: ubiquitous 之后的 since 从句用过去时，主句完成时。
改写：Smartphones arrived; attention is still fragmented.
exercises.answer: Attention has been fragmented since smartphones arrived.

exercises.q: 改错：Since smartphones have become common, attention became fragmented.
exercises.answer: Since smartphones became common, attention has become fragmented.

exercises.q: Few athletes ______ such a rebound after that injury.
The death rate ______ to a plateau; further gains will require new tactics.
What ______ the sport ______ since it was introduced into schools?
Only recently ______ researchers ______ the cardiovascular cost of chronic loneliness.
exercises.explain: Only recently 引起倒装 have researchers documented。

exercises.q: No previous champion ______ (overcome) a comparable setback.
Passion ______ (not fade) even though the court was empty.
完成时可用于比较“到目前为止无人/少有人做成”。
改写：Until now, no starter succeeded without a parachute check.
exercises.answer: No starter has succeeded without a parachute check.

exercises.q: 改写：The rate went down and remains low.
改错：Few has insisted on safety as strongly as she has.
exercises.answer: Few have insisted on safety as strongly as she has.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语及相关形式（It is + adj. + to do / 动名词复合结构）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as subject and related forms
grammar.usage:
动名词（V-ing）可作主语，表示一种活动或习惯，谓语用单数。
Knowing yourself is crucial.
否定：Not getting enough sleep affects your mood.
可用 it 作形式主语：It is crucial to know yourself.（不定式更常见）
初中：不要把动名词主语当成进行时；谓语用 is/was/helps，不用 are。
高中：复合结构 Tom's/Tom being late 作主语；动名词与不定式作主语的细微差别（动名词偏泛指习惯，不定式偏具体/将来）；There is no + doing；worth doing。
forms: It's + adj. + (for sb) + to do（近义转换）
所有格/宾格 + V-ing（复合结构）
There is no + V-ing / be worth + V-ing
notes: 动名词主语视为单数。
不要写成 To knowing 或 Know yourself is...（祈使不能直接当主语）。
否定是 Not doing，不是 Don't doing。
It's no use + doing；be busy doing。
动名词作主语 ≠ 现在进行时。

examples.en: Reading every night helps me sleep.
examples.cn: 每晚阅读帮助我入睡。

examples.en: Helping others makes us happier.
examples.cn: 帮助别人让我们更快乐。

examples.en: Knowing yourself without judgement is crucial for defining yourself.
examples.cn: 不加评判地了解自己，对定义自己至关重要。

examples.en: Interrupting others constantly ruins a conversation.
examples.cn: 不断打断别人会毁掉谈话。

examples.en: Building empathy takes more than a single compliment.
examples.cn: 建立共情需要的不只是一句恭维。

examples.en: Reducing fragmented attention is essential for deep work.
examples.cn: 减少碎片化注意力对深度工作至关重要。

exercises.q: ______ breakfast is important.
Collecting stamps ______ (be) fun.
“Read books is fun.” 是正确的。
改写：If you exercise, you will feel better. → 动名词作主语。
exercises.answer: Exercising makes you feel better. / Exercising will make you feel better.

exercises.q: 改错：To reading in bed is relaxing.
Playing games ______ him happy.
Choose the correct sentence.
______ late is impolite.
Walking after dinner ______ me relax.
Not ______ (do) homework will get you in trouble.
______ (Listen) to music helps her focus.
改为否定主语：Getting up late is a bad habit.
exercises.answer: Not getting up late is a good habit. / Getting up late is not a good habit.
exercises.explain: 两种否定，推荐 Not getting up late is a good idea. 题意：Not getting up late is good. 标准：Getting up late is not a good habit.

exercises.q: 用 It's 改写：Learning a language is useful.
exercises.answer: It is useful to learn a language.

exercises.q: 改错：Knowing English help you travel.
动名词作主语时谓语常用复数。
______ a hand is always welcome.
Opening up to a friend ______ (require) trust.
“Let's helping” 是动名词作主语。
改写：If you listen carefully, you learn more.
exercises.answer: Listening carefully helps you learn more.

exercises.q: 改错：Not pay attention is risky.
Not ______ attention causes mistakes.
______ twice saves you trouble.
Helping others ______ never a waste of time.
Which is correct?
options: To keeping a promise builds trust.

exercises.q: Not ______ (interrupt) is a basic rule.
______ (Paraphrase) can prevent misunderstanding.
It's no use crying 中 crying 是动名词。
否定主语：Paying attention is optional. → 强调必须注意。
exercises.answer: Not paying attention is dangerous. / Paying attention is not optional.

exercises.q: It's no use 改写：Don't wait without acting.
exercises.answer: It's no use waiting without acting.

exercises.q: 改错：To interrupting others is rude.
Not ______ your values makes identity unstable.
Pinning down a direction ______ (help) later life.
动名词作主语时可以随意改成进行时 you are knowing。
exercises.explain: know 一般不用进行时，且结构不同。

exercises.q: 用 It's 改写：Gaining insight into identity takes patience.
exercises.answer: It takes patience to gain insight into identity.

exercises.q: 改错：Define yourself well is not easy.
exercises.answer: Defining yourself well is not easy.

exercises.q: ______ from struggles builds insight.
Which is NOT a gerund subject?
options: Try to know yourself from intimate relationships.
Comparing yourself with others can hurt.
Getting rid of negative talk helps.
exercises.answer: Try to know yourself from intimate relationships.

exercises.q: ______ out to mentors requires a little bravery.
Underestimating yourself ______ progress.
Not ______ (get) rid of negative thoughts drowns out your voice.
______ (Adopt) a realistic pace is necessary.
It's crucial to know yourself 与 Knowing yourself is crucial 近义。
否定：Comparing yourself with others is helpful. → 相反观点。
exercises.answer: Comparing yourself with others is not helpful. / Not comparing yourself with others is wiser.

exercises.q: 复合结构：Tom is late. This annoyed us. → Tom's ...
改错：Not get rid of fear keeps you stuck.
exercises.answer: Not getting rid of fear keeps you stuck.

exercises.q: Not ______ a book by its cover prevents prejudice.
Keeping in mind the context ______ (prevent) slips of the tongue from snowballing.
Tom being late 在正式语里不如 Tom's being late 稳妥。
复合：The partner was frank. That surprised us.
exercises.answer: The partner's being frank surprised us.

exercises.q: 改错：Not judge a book by its cover is wise.
exercises.answer: Not judging a book by its cover is wise.

exercises.q: ______ others' conversations is a fast way to lose trust.
Which uses a gerund subject?
options: To confronting a stereotype takes courage.

exercises.q: ______ roles for a day might increase empathy.
Self-disclosure ______ not the same as oversharing.
exercises.explain: 名词/动名词概念用 is。

exercises.q: Not ______ (dominate) the discussion leaves space for others.
______ (Paraphrase) what you heard reduces conflict.
动名词主语可以随意用复数谓语 are。
There is no 改写：You cannot deny the value of empathy.

grammar.key: Modal Verb for Suggestion / 表建议的情态动词
grammar.title: 祈使句表建议/命令，及 Let's / Don't / Always / Never
grammar.titleEn: Imperative sentences for advice (Let's / Don't / Always)
grammar.usage:
祈使句以动词原形开头，省略主语 you，用来发出指令、请求或建议。
肯定：Try again. / Please wait here.
否定：Don't be late. / Never underestimate yourself.
Let's + 原形 表示包括说话人在内的建议；Let's not + 原形 表示建议不要做。
初中：不要在句首加 You 当作祈使；不要加 to。
高中：Always / Never 可放在祈使句首加强语气；Do + 原形 表强调（Do sit down.）；祈使句 + and/or + 将来结果（Work hard, and you will improve / Hurry up, or you will miss it）。与不定式作主语（To try is important）和条件句区分。
forms: 祈使句, and/or + 主语 + will ...
notes: 句首用原形，不要 to try / You try 当作祈使建议。
否定用 Don't，不是 Doesn't。
Let's 后是原形，不是 Let's to。
Please 可前可后，不影响动词形式。
祈使+and 可改写为 If 条件句。

grammar.title: No matter how / however 引导让步状语从句
grammar.usage:
No matter how + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语：No matter how hard you try, ...
however + adj./adv. + S + V 同义，更书面。
相关：no matter what/who/where = whatever/whoever/wherever。
however 也可作“然而”的副词，注意标点与位置。
forms: No matter how + adj./adv. + S + V
notes: how 后先接形容词再接主语。
不要 No matter how you hard try。
从句用陈述语序。
however 两种用法要分清。
主句不要再用 but。

grammar.key: Adjective + Infinitive (It's + adj + to do) / 形容词+不定式
grammar.title: It is + adj. + (for sb) + to do 及 that 从句 / of sb
grammar.titleEn: It is + adjective + for/of someone + to do
grammar.usage:
形式主语 it 代替真正的不定式：It is important for you to take action.
for sb 指出不定式的逻辑主语；评价人的品格用 of sb：It is kind of you to help.
也可用 that 从句：It is important that you (should) take action.
高中：It is + adj. + that 虚拟（essential/necessary 后 should + 原形可省 should）。
forms: It is + adj. + for sb + to do
It is + adj. + of sb + to do
notes: 真正主语是 to do，不要再加 a thing。
for 与 of 不要混。
necessary 后 that 从句常用 should + 原形。
It's no use doing 不是 to do。
题干直接练结构，不必标注考试名称。

grammar.key: Present Simple Passive Voice / 一般现在时被动语态
grammar.title: 一般现在时被动语态及相关：am/is/are + 过去分词 / by
grammar.titleEn: Present simple passive and related forms
grammar.usage:
当承受者比执行者更重要时用被动：S + am/is/are + 过去分词 (+ by 执行者)。
否定：am/is/are not + V-ed；疑问：Am/Is/Are + S + V-ed。
初中：by 可省略；不规则动词用过去分词（written, made）。
高中：含情态的被动 must be done；双宾语改为 to/for；get-passive 偏口语。不及物动词没有被动。It is said that / sb is said to do 是书面常见转换。
forms: It is said that ... / sb is said to ...
notes: 不要漏 be。
过去分词不是过去式。
by 后接执行者。
不及物动词无被动。
get done 较口语。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词'can'表能力/可能性
grammar.title: 情态动词 can 表能力/可能性，及 could / be able to / may / might
grammar.titleEn: Modal can for ability and possibility (could / be able to / may / might)
grammar.usage:
can 后接动词原形，表示现在的能力、客观可能性或许可。
肯定：She can swim. 否定：cannot / can't。疑问：Can you help me?
could 是 can 的过去式，也可表示更委婉的现在请求或较弱可能性。
be able to 有时态变化，强调经过努力而做成。
初中：记住 can + 原形，没有 cans、没有 to。
高中：表推测时，肯定推测常用 must，否定推测常用 can't（不可能）；may/might 表可能；could have done 表过去本可以。不要用 can 表示过去某一次具体做成（宜用 was able to / managed to）。
forms: S + could + V（过去能力 / 委婉 / 弱可能）
S + be able to + V（各种时态）
推测：must / may / might / can't + V 或 have done
notes: can 后不加 to，也不加 -s。
过去某一次成功做成，多用 was able to，不只说 could。
can't 表“不可能”时，不要写成 mustn't（mustn't 是禁止）。
be able to 可与 will/have 连用，can 不能。
could 不一定等于过去，也可能是委婉。

examples.en: I can ride a bike, but I can't drive a car.
examples.cn: 我会骑自行车，但不会开车。

examples.en: Mentors can be family members, or they can be close friends.
examples.cn: 导师可以是家人，也可以是密友。

examples.cn: 模糊的目标如果一步步确定下来，仍然可以变清晰。

examples.en: After three months of training she was able to give the speech without notes.
examples.cn: 经过三个月训练，她终于能脱稿演讲了。

examples.en: The noise from the street might drown out the recording, so we should close the window.
examples.cn: 街上的噪音可能会盖过录音，所以我们应当关窗。

examples.en: The witness can't have seen the suspect clearly; the streetlight was out.
examples.cn: 目击者不可能看清嫌疑人，因为路灯当时灭了。

动名词（V-ing）可作主语，表示一种活动或习惯，谓语用单数。
Knowing yourself is crucial.
否定：Not getting enough sleep affects your mood.
可用 it 作形式主语：It is crucial to know yourself.（不定式更常见）
初中：不要把动名词主语当成进行时；谓语用 is/was/helps，不用 are。
高中：复合结构 Tom's/Tom being late 作主语；动名词与不定式作主语的细微差别（动名词偏泛指习惯，不定式偏具体/将来）；There is no + doing；worth doing。
forms: It's + adj. + (for sb) + to do（近义转换）
所有格/宾格 + V-ing（复合结构）
There is no + V-ing / be worth + V-ing
notes: 动名词主语视为单数。
不要写成 To knowing 或 Know yourself is...（祈使不能直接当主语）。
否定是 Not doing，不是 Don't doing。
It's no use + doing；be busy doing。
动名词作主语 ≠ 现在进行时。
